finalText:
Build's green now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the dependency bump, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (undefined), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit booleans and threw otherwise. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the "screen full of warnings" (DEP0142/198/233/250/267, unused-export, circular-import, etc.) is just noise baked into the build log — those 8 warnings still print but no longer fail the build.
